name: Tavernerio (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tavernerio (quartered: a mountain and stars, a bear, a cornucopia and a bear) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Tavernerio, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 25 October 1999.

features.role: Tavernerio arms — quartered with stars, a bear and a cornucopia, crowned, within branches
